totals.title: Totals (working model)
totals.mainPathHint_one: Processing + waiting time of the start-to-end path that takes longest ({{count}} step). Loops back are not counted.
totals.mainPathHint_other: Processing + waiting time of the start-to-end path that takes longest ({{count}} steps). Loops back are not counted.
totals.withoutTime_one: {{count}} step has no planned processing time.

reports.handbookHint: A Word document with cover page, contents and, per process: description, owner, version and approval data, diagram, steps with roles, IT systems and attributes, linked documents and SOP pages.
reports.raciHint: An Excel workbook: steps × roles (R = performs, A = approves), IT systems per step, the steps with their attributes.
reports.sourceHint: The published version is the official one in the Knowledge Portal.
